title: Out Of Focus
description: Can't see anything? Perfect. A fully configurable blur shaderpack ranging from Subtle to WHY.
body:
![Out Of Focus Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b26515e28f5316a42e4c6ff14ee027b638d7573a.png)
Out of Focus is a Shader Pack that makes everything in game blurry including any items you are holding and mobs that you may see. It's mimics what it's like to lose your glasses.
# Before and after: ![Before and after image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b04abecbc3f223e1ec8e8111a1ff23bb8d00e1c4.png)
![Out Of Focus FAQ:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4a8b43fa18b13d73b64d8c79d35244a122a5e85.png) Here are some Frequently Asked Questions that I ask myself.
Frequently Asked Questions **Why did you make this?** > I just thought that it might be funny to make something like this. It could be a good challenge for someone to try and beat minecraft with. **Is it laggy?** > So far on the computer I tested, it's not bad at all. I get a mostly decent framerate with it, and it shouldn't lag your's too bad either. In fact, while testing it, I noticed I actually got MORE frames per second when it was enabled. **How strong is the blur?** > There are 8 different levels of blur:
3 = Subtle
5 = A little Blurry
7 = Blurry
10 = Blurrier
14 = Blurriest
30 = Way Too Blurry
50 = Sir, This is a Wendy's
100 = WHY

"Sir, This is a Wendy's" is the one used in the image. **What type of blur is it?** > Gaussian blur
